goal: Verify that a user can create a new Site Host account, navigate to the June 2026 calendar view, and successfully switch to the previous year (2025) using the calendar navigation controls.

findings.instruction: In the top-right corner of the 2026 calendar view, click the left-pointing arrow button (labeled 'Previous year') to navigate to the previous year.
findings.title: Missing year navigation controls in the full-year calendar view
findings.description: The test goal requires navigating from the 2026 calendar view to the 2025 view using a 'Previous year' button. However, the full-year calendar view (visible in Step 1's screenshot) only provides 'Previous month' and 'Next month' navigation arrows, not year-level navigation. This prevents the user from fulfilling the core requirement of switching to the previous year as specified in the success criteria.
findings.evidence: Step 1's screenshot shows the full-year 2026 calendar with navigation arrows labeled '<' and '>' next to a 'TODAY' button, but no explicit 'Previous year' or 'Next year' controls. The automation failure message confirms: 'The UI only supports month-level navigation, not year-level.' The current step failed because the required UI element does not exist.
reproduction_steps: Click on the calendar widget to open the full-year view for 2026.
Attempt to locate and click a 'Previous year' button to navigate to 2025.
Observe that only month-level navigation controls are available, making year navigation impossible.
